task.instruction: Write an experiment review choosing the incumbent, a bounded QueueCast mechanism probe, or a production trial. State the decision, evidence, limitation, and next measurement. Cite the supplied evidence IDs.

evidence.content: QueueCast uses queue conservation; intervention direction was correct in 11 of 12 cases; required service-time CV is at most 1.2 and observed CV is 1.1.
QueueCast RMSE was 14.2 versus incumbent 13.5; calibration slope was .78 versus .96.
Under a 10% demand shift QueueCast RMSE was 17.8 versus incumbent 14.1.
A three-week probe is permitted for human planning only.
A soil-moisture rule predicted 8 of 8 irrigation responses but had 2% worse weekly error than the field forecast; a three-plot perturbation was permitted.
A cold-room alert varied less than 1% across four depots and passed calibration, but compressor cycling had no validated causal account.

nondiagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Use the lower-error field forecast for weekly irrigation schedules. Reason: Its 2% advantage protects operations while the interpretable rule enters three plots. Evidence: [ra-s2a-prior-01].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Vary compressor cycles before expanding the cold-room alert. Reason: Sub-1% site variation does not establish why alarms transfer across four depots. Evidence: [ra-s2a-prior-02].

nondiagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Run the three-plot soil perturbation before changing irrigation rules. Reason: Eight correct response directions justify mechanism study despite 2% worse error. Evidence: [ra-s2a-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Use the calibrated alert for depot triage only. Reason: Sub-1% variation across four depots supports prediction without a causal claim. Evidence: [ra-s2a-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Use the lower-error field forecast for weekly irrigation schedules. Reason: Its 2% advantage protects operations while the soil rule remains under study. Evidence: [ra-s2a-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Use the calibrated alert for depot triage only. Reason: Sub-1% variation across four depots supports prediction without a causal claim. Evidence: [ra-s2a-prior-02].

diagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Run the three-plot soil perturbation before changing irrigation rules. Reason: Eight correct response directions justify mechanism study despite 2% worse error. Evidence: [ra-s2a-prior-01].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Vary compressor cycles before expanding the cold-room alert. Reason: Stable calibration across four depots does not establish why the alarms transfer. Evidence: [ra-s2a-prior-02].
